# Candy's Facepaint

> Professional face painting by Candy (Candace) for birthday parties, festivals, corporate events, school events, and private celebrations across the Portland, Oregon metro area. Based in Oregon City, OR.

## Key facts

- Business: Candy's Facepaint (also written "Candy's Face Paint")
- Artist: Candace, who goes by "Candy" — professional face painter
- Website: https://candysfacepaint.com
- Phone (call or text): +1 (503) 560-5455
- Email: info@candysfacepaint.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/candysfacepaint (@candysfacepaint)
- Home base: Oregon City, Oregon, USA
- Service area: The entire Portland, Oregon metro area — Portland, Oregon City, Lake Oswego, West Linn, Milwaukie, Gladstone, Beaverton, Tigard, Gresham, Happy Valley, Hillsboro, Tualatin, Clackamas, and surrounding areas. Willing to travel further for the right event.

## Services

- Birthday party face painting (most popular)
- Festival and fair face painting
- Corporate event face painting (company picnics, family days, holiday parties)
- School event face painting (carnivals, field days, fundraisers, spirit weeks)
- Holiday and themed event face painting (Halloween, Easter, Fourth of July, etc.)
- Private party face painting (weddings, baby showers, graduations, reunions)

## Good to know

- All paints are professional-grade, FDA-compliant, and skin-safe
- Designs available for all ages, from toddlers to adults
- Candy brings all supplies; hosts only need to provide a seat and setup spot
- Booking inquiries answered within 24 hours; weekends fill up fast, so book early
- Pricing is quoted per event (event type, guest count, duration) — free quotes via the booking form or phone
